summary: RPL is an IPv6 routing protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks, where routers have little processing power, memory, and battery, and links are lossy and unstable. It is a distance vector protocol that builds a directed acyclic graph and supports several traffic patterns.

eli5.summary: Tiny battery-powered gadgets, like sensors, must pass messages along. This lets them find paths even when their radio links drop out often.

questions: ipv6 routing for low power lossy networks
